population_definition: all kernels in shard FV-PROPFLOOR-SHARD-B12-1, enumerated below by kernel id and spec digest
independence_sentence: Each item listed was reviewed and attested independently; the single signature is a mechanical convenience over the enumerated digests, not a bulk review.
per_item_basis_of_review: Every row ran the same two mechanical checks unconditionally: (1) the fixture-oracle gate — compute() output diffed against the kernel's own existing golden fixtures before any property was trusted, and (2) run-proptests.mjs green (process exit 0). ULP-boundary forcing was mandatory and present for the 8 float-sensitive rows named in the WU (art-319, art-320, art-321, art-327, art-328, art-329, art-330, art-331 — the five tvm-* rows additionally force near-zero-rate and near-zero-duration edge cases per the WU's explicit instruction, since TVM formulas divide by rate/duration terms). The other 2 rows (art-314, art-316) are the row's stated float:no exceptions and instead carry forced CATEGORICAL boundary cases (missing/non-object policy_parameters fields, unrecognized enum strings, exact threshold-string boundaries) in place of ULP forcing. Three monotonicity/round-trip property definitions were corrected during authoring after direct measurement against the kernel found the initial tolerance or domain assumption false: art-327's annuity-identity tolerance needed to scale with annuity_factor to absorb r2-rounding amplification; art-328's round-trip check needed to reconstruct unit_contribution from raw (unrounded) inputs rather than the r4-rounded output field; art-331's maturity-monotonicity property is restricted to the short/medium-maturity regime ([0.25,10]yr +2yr) because measurement showed convexity legitimately humps and can decrease at long-maturity/high-yield combinations for deep-discount bonds — a real financial effect, not a floor defect, so the property was narrowed rather than the kernel. No row beyond these mechanical checks received a separate in-depth human review in this pass — that is exactly the gap human_sign_off.status=PENDING names.
